WITH ticket_window AS (
  SELECT
    t.id,
    t.tenant_id,
    t.channel,
    CASE WHEN t.assignee_agent_id IS NULL THEN 'Unassigned' ELSE 'Assigned' END AS assignment_status,
    t.created_at,
    t.first_response_at,
    t.resolved_at
  FROM tickets t
  WHERE t.created_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND t.created_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
ticket_breach_flags AS (
  SELECT
    tw.id AS ticket_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN sb.breach_kind = 'first_response' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_response_breached,
    MAX(CASE WHEN sb.breach_kind = 'resolution' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS resolution_breached
  FROM ticket_window tw
  LEFT JOIN sla_breaches sb
    ON sb.ticket_id = tw.id AND sb.tenant_id = tw.tenant_id
  GROUP BY tw.id
),
ticket_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    tw.id,
    tw.channel,
    tw.assignment_status,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tw.first_response_at - tw.created_at)) / 60.0 AS first_response_minutes,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (tw.resolved_at - tw.created_at)) / 60.0 AS resolution_minutes,
    bf.first_response_breached,
    bf.resolution_breached
  FROM ticket_window tw
  JOIN ticket_breach_flags bf ON bf.ticket_id = tw.id
)
SELECT
  channel,
  assignment_status,
  COUNT(*) AS ticket_count,
  ROUND(AVG(first_response_minutes)::numeric, 0) AS avg_first_response_minutes,
  ROUND(AVG(resolution_minutes)::numeric, 0) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(first_response_breached)::numeric, 1) AS first_response_breach_rate,
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(resolution_breached)::numeric, 1) AS resolution_breach_rate
FROM ticket_metrics
GROUP BY channel, assignment_status
ORDER BY avg_resolution_minutes DESC, channel, assignment_status
note: I did not receive the companion audit's confirmed breach_kind codes, so this uses 'first_response' and 'resolution' as the breach_kind values in sla_breaches; please swap in the corrected codes if the audit found different ones. Avg minutes are computed only over tickets that have a first_response_at/resolved_at timestamp (unanswered/unresolved tickets are excluded from those two averages but still count in ticket_count and breach rates).
